notes.title: Witching Tower VR’s birthday!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have an especially good mood today and do you know why? Because today we’re celebrating our Witching Tower VR’s birthday!

[b]We added French localization:)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32058515/f5c08667e8075daed90257493b8da012ad1b441b.jpg[/img]

Exactly a year ago Witching Tower VR appeared on Steam and we’re so excited about it! In honor of this amazing day, we’d like as many people as possible to get acquainted with our game, so we’re presenting a - 80% discount.

Hurry up to get it because the sale is only today (October, 26), starting at 10:00 AM (PT)!
Celebrate with us and enjoy

From the bottom of our hearts,

notes.title: Long awaited update of Witching Tower
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

[h1]Today our team will release the last updated version of Witching Tower⚡️[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/71508bcf712160b59bac71ce3bf915454fba8e25.jpg[/img]


[h1]The main features of the patch are improved combat system and improved locomotion🔥[/h1]

With a new fight system, locomotion and smarter enemies, battles look more dynamic and exciting. Also our game now [b]supports Russian language[/b], [b]3dRudder[/b] and has settings of smooth turning.

In honor of this update it has an additional nice feature which is a 50% discount on Steam⚡️

Hope, you enjoy the game process. Thank you for helping to make the game more pleasant to play❤️ 

So, follow our news, and stay in touch not to miss it. Feel free to leave a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800200/discussions/]feedback[/url]. Thank you for leaving a feedback and helping to make a game better!

notes.title: First update 2019 is coming❤️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[h1]Finally, we've prepared an update that includes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Chinese localization;
[*] Japanese localization;
[*] German localization;
[*] Fixed error with the Queen - she could dissappear before;
[*] Also we fixed some errors connected with savings, navigation, sounds and control.
[/list]

This update is also on a review in Oculus Store and HTC VIVEPORT. A release is coming in the end of the week or at the beginning of a following one.

By the way, our [b]Trading Cards[/b] are going to appear in Steam this week. They are already on a Steam review. Cards turned out cool and backgrounds are fascinating like thousands dawns!

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

We're working on a locomotion, Russian localization, fighting and archery. Even now you will see some changes when fighting with a skeleton - killing him became not that easy. Soon it is going to be even better.

So, follow our news, and stay in touch not to miss it. Feel free to leave a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800200/discussions/]feedback[/url]. Thank you for leaving a feedback and helping to make a game better!

notes.title: Christmas patch has arrived!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone! [/h1]

Daily Magic Productions and Witching Tower team wish you [b]Happy New Year and Merry Christmas[/b]. We hope that the upcoming 2019 year will be successful, a lot of fun and fascinating for you❤️ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/afc1b43b4a48d9940b71bdba7af00145f5c06ea1.jpg[/img]

[h1]For New Year holidays our team has prepared a Witching Tower VR update that includes the following:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Improved optimization.[/b] We worked hard and successfully improved an optimization of our game. Now the game process is more comfortable even on a low system requirements. We almost went through the whole game to achieve this result.
[*][b]Fixed bug.[/b] The game had a moment in a prologue where it was possible to fall down. That bag was also fixed. 
[*][b]Fixed bug.[/b] From time to time a key in a room wasn’t active. We fixed this error and now everything works correctly.
[*][b]Updated Oculus version.[/b] A distance to getting an object was increased in Oculus version. Now there’s no need to squat:)
[/list]
This list is much longer, but we decided to publish only important fixes.

Very important upcoming events for our Witching Tower VR to do before the New Year are: 
[list]
[*] Release on Oculus Store; 
[*] German and Russian localizations.
[/list]

[b]And in January there will be available Japanese localization[/b]. So, follow our news, and stay in touch not to miss it. Feel free to leave a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800200/discussions/]feedback[/url]. Hope, that now it’s more enjoyable to play the game.

notes.title: Halloween patch!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

[b]Happy Halloween! Boo![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/2aefa6662b09112c9a7cdd4019d5fcfcb04af840.jpg[/img]

On this Halloween holiday, we have prepared one small, but important update for you.

[h1]So what's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Snap Turning.[/b] Now, when you click on the touchpad left or right, you will turn 45'.
[*] [b]Controler directional locomotion.[/b] You can enable this feature in the settings.
[*] Fixed some not critical bugs.
[*] Improved optimization, but we continue to work on it.
[*] We also made several cosmetic changes.
[/list]

We really appreciate your feedback and will continue to quickly correct errors. Feel free to write us in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800200/discussions/]Community Hub discussions[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/witchingtower/]social media[/url], please keep going! We highly appreciate the time and effort you’ve put in helping us to improve the game. 

Thank you!❤️

notes.title: Hot Fix goes live!
notes.notes:
Hi, everybody! Our team has [b]released hot fix[/b] which solves the majority of performance issues. 

Thank you all for the comments and suggestions in the Community Hub! We will continue monitoring your comments to react to any issues asap.

The next patch will arrive by the end of next week.

If you have any questions, we will be more than happy to answer them in the comments below and in the Community Hub.

notes.title: WITCHING TOWER HAS GONE GOLD
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 

Exactly in one day our first ever VR game Witching Tower will see the world. It was a long journey lasting one year, we have discovered a lot for ourselves, opened new horizons and possibilities. We are tired but immensely proud to finish such a new and difficult for us project. We can surely say that we made the impossible come true and did our absolute best😍

So with heart filled with joy we can finally announce that we are at the finish line and starting [b]tomorrow 10am PDT[/b] the game will be available on Steam and HTC VIVEPORT. We are grateful to our friends and family and everyone who believed in us and want to say thank you so much for your support❤️

After release we won't stop working on the project and will do our best to react to your reviews and suggestions to make the game better. This is our first time making such a big project for VR so we are hoping for your support.

Best, Witching Tower Team.

notes.title: New release date — October, 25th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we have decided to reschedule the release of the Witching Tower VR, so [b]now it will be on October, 25th[/b]. 

It is a difficult decision and we believe that it is truly correct. Our purpose is to make the game that will be pleasant to play, without facing any problems. 

In fact, all content is ready. However, technically we still have tasks connected with an optimization. [b]We want to provide you a comfortable playing with stable 90 FPS.[/b]

Hope for your understanding.

notes.title: The Torture room - The end is near...
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We want to tell you that today we’ve finished working on one of the levels - [b]the Torture room[/b].

Once upon a time this floor was residential, but after the Queen stole an ability, she remade it by creating a horrible hall where unimaginable tortures conducted on people associated with magic were being kept. Their prison cells surrounded the room where the Queen put her prisoners.

You’re going to meet miserable ghosts deviously wandering on the floor. Once upon a time they were magicians, wizards and enchanters but when Queen started her rule, she had her pawns torture them to death. Their souls slithering on the floor hoping that someone could free them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058515/2c64e7656daa54bc2e48e116ba4d724d559a5a32.jpg[/img]

Also, a new foe has appeared! - Hangman - will be waiting for you on the level. To defeat him you need to think carefully and be inventive.

In an upcoming article I’ll tell you about another location - [b]the Library[/b]. So keep in touch!ːsteamhappyː
